name: Thymalin (Thymulin)
storage: Store at -20 °C, protected from light and moisture.
definition: Thymalin (Thymulin) (TY) is a linear synthetic peptide supplied as white lyophilized powder. The catalogue lists 1 pack size: 10 mg. The CAS number, full sequence and molecular weight are recorded in the lot-specific certificate of analysis (COA). Purity is stated at ≥99.0% (HPLC) with white lyophilized powder appearance. Each kit contains 10 vials; minimum order quantity is 1 kit. Store the lyophilized powder at -20 °C, protected from light and moisture. For laboratory research use only; not for human or veterinary use.

faq.question: How is Thymalin (Thymulin) tested for purity and identity?
faq.answer: Each TY lot is run on RP-HPLC against a ≥99.0% (HPLC) release limit, then confirmed by MS. The batch certificate carries the measured purity, retention time and mass together with the identity string (CAS 78922-62-0, formula C33H54N12O15, 858.9 Da).

faq.question: How should Thymalin (Thymulin) be stored?
faq.answer: Hold the sealed 10-vial kit at −20 °C, away from light and humidity. Once reconstituted, aliquot and keep at 2–8 °C; this TY preparation does not tolerate repeated freeze–thaw.

faq.question: What pack sizes are available for Thymalin (Thymulin)?
faq.answer: Thymalin (Thymulin) is stocked in 1 pack size (10 mg), 10 vials per kit, MOQ 1 kit. At 1–9 kits the per-kit price is $66.86; 10–49 kits falls to $61.52 (−8%) and 50+ to $56.84 (−15%).
